verses.text: People make plans in their hearts, but the right answer comes from the LORD.
People think everything they do is right, but the LORD weighs their motives.
Give everything you do to the LORD, and your plans will succeed.
The LORD has made everything for its own purpose, even the wicked for the day of disaster.
The LORD hates everyone with a proud heart. You can be sure they will be punished.
Faithful love and truth make up for sin. Respect for the LORD keeps people away from evil.
When the LORD is pleased with how someone lives, he makes even their enemies live at peace with them.
It is better to have a little and do what is right than to have a large income and be unfair.
People plan their path in their hearts, but the LORD decides where their steps will go.
A king speaks as if his words come from God. He must not be unfair when he judges.
Honest scales and balances belong to the LORD. He made all the weights in the bag.
Kings hate it when people do wrong, because a throne is made secure by doing what is right.
Kings are pleased with honest words. They value people who speak the truth.
A king's anger can mean death, but a wise person will calm him down.
When a king is happy, it means life. His favour is like a cloud that brings spring rain.
It is much better to get wisdom than gold, and better to choose understanding than silver.
The road of honest people avoids evil. Whoever watches where they go protects their life.
Pride comes before destruction, and a proud spirit comes before a fall.
It is better to be humble and live among the poor than to share stolen goods with proud people.
Whoever pays attention to good teaching will do well. Happy is the person who trusts in the LORD.
People with wise hearts are known for their understanding, and kind words make teaching easier to accept.
Understanding is a fountain of life to those who have it, but foolishness brings punishment to fools.
The heart of a wise person guides their mouth, and makes their words more convincing.
Kind words are like honey. They are sweet to the soul and bring healing to the body.
There is a way that seems right to a person, but in the end it leads to death.
A worker's hunger makes him work. His empty stomach drives him on.
Worthless people plan evil. Their words are like a burning fire.
A twisted person stirs up fights, and gossip separates close friends.
A violent person tempts their neighbour and leads them down a path that is not good.
Whoever winks while plotting evil, whoever purses their lips, is already set on doing wrong.
Grey hair is a glorious crown. It is earned by living a good life.
It is better to be patient than to be a powerful warrior. It is better to control your temper than to capture a city.
People throw dice into their laps, but every decision comes from the LORD.
